en: Black-and-white multi-view postcard. Left: a bronze modernist statue of two people, one in a long coat, both standing upright and looking upwards. Top-right: a hilly vineyard with posts and vines descending toward a town and a river plain in the background. Bottom-right: a domed observatory building with a ribbed metal dome on a stone drum adjoining a flat-roofed annex; there is a rectangular plaque on the wall but its text is not legible.
